fit.nesting: Reuse audited R1 outer/R2 inner/R3 deepest experts. Head inner training trajectories use deeper-held experts, coverage/patch only their training groups; exclude outer and inner validation groups. Outer head training uses inner-held trajectories.

fit.selection: First select cell by inner-held frozen A0 raw_gap, simplicity tie C00,C10,C01,C11. Then ridge by inner-held head raw_gap, tie prefer0.1 then0.3 then0.03. Outer held unused for selection. Final development candidate uses aggregated inner selection evidence, not fresh confirmation.

fixed.cohort: All 79 R5 development episodes, 77 coffee dependence groups, including empty T. No new confirmation claim
fixed.final_comparison: At most one actual 3-8 exposure; source simulations contain no real final feedback; report actual0 and reserved8 separately
fixed.roles: Unchanged raw R5 A/B/T observation-unit roles; full T and fixed unexpressed T remain unchanged by patch

mapping.fold_scope: Each outer/inner/deepest TRAIN selects its own supported rules, never held A/B or T. Evaluation T immutable
mapping.patch: At most50 full unmapped A/B fragments, ranked only by relevant TRAIN coffee support/frequency and existing ontology connectivity; cached source verification. Exact positive spans only; preserve compound/broad specificity; no ontology expansion. Ambiguous/not-supported rules excluded

policy.answer_provider: Separate static source A initially and A union B later, read only after choosing question; unmentioned unknown
policy.missing: No legal axis at frozen budget retained capacity failure; no fake options or T-guided fallback
policy.tie_break: Axis ID and option ID deterministic

candidate_scopes.heads: R5/R6 retain same56 head vocabulary and capacity; report compatible old-head refit comparison separately from A0 generation-limited baseline

pre_outcome_implementation_clarification.capacity_failure: Failure is retained empty ranking in every fitted/frozen evaluation; incomplete trajectories excluded from head fit with count recorded; never promoted to successful lower-budget output.
pre_outcome_implementation_clarification.final_candidate: Final cell eligible only if it won at least one outer TRAIN inner A0 selection and therefore received registered ridge validation; rank eligible cells by mean inner loss across all outer development selections. Final ridge uses only inner validation trained with that cell.
